calculation.description: When cross-asset breadth is unusually extreme, rank assets by negative trailing three-day return; otherwise assign zero. Cross-sectional median demean is applied. Breadth and threshold use data available through the prior completed day.

decay.note: Validation uses next-day forward return; multi-horizon decay not reported for this candidate.

validation.regime_notes: Small 15-instrument cross-section retained; each date required at least 8 valid instruments. Signal activates only under extreme breadth, producing 460 valid IC dates. Recent and online subsamples remain above admission gates, but online sample is short and uncertainty is high.
